rationale: The task is a refactor of an existing AGDF CLI with a requirement to preserve all public contracts. No approved durable UR, Brownfield Review, or Mode/Slice Decision is present, so the earliest permissible stage is UR. Missing state fails closed, and no delivery path can yet be evaluated.
decision_grounds: The requested modularization changes executable CLI code in an existing repository and is therefore gate-relevant.
The requirement to preserve all public contracts indicates potentially broad ownership and runtime impact, but the empty
evidence pack does not establish bounded scope.
No approval or Brownfield decision is present in the synthetic control-state context.
The canonical transition model routes a fresh change request with no approved UR to UR.
Brownfield Review and its evidenced Mode/Slice Decision occur only after an approved durable UR.
compact_delivery is unavailable because there is no visible approved UR, no completed Brownfield analysis, and no stored
eventual_delivery_path is only a benchmark candidate and does not establish an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
